hero.title: Discover Vaavu
hero.subtitle: Islandbreak Excursion · V. Fulidhoo, Maldives
hero.description: Dive into the crystal-clear waters of Vaavu Atoll. Experience the magic of the Indian Ocean aboard our vessel Jasmine.

about.body1: Discover Vaavu is the excursion arm of Island Break Guest House, nestled on the beautiful island of Fulidhoo in Vaavu Atoll. We bring you the finest ocean adventures the Maldives has to offer — from swimming with whale sharks to watching dolphins dance at sunset.
about.body2: Our boat Jasmine is your gateway to Vaavu's pristine reefs, hidden sandbars, and abundant marine life. Every trip is crafted to give you an authentic, unforgettable Maldivian experience.

excursions.title: Shark Point
excursions.shortDesc: Snorkel alongside black tip reef sharks and eagle rays at Fulidhoo's famous Shark Point.
excursions.fullDesc: Shark Point is one of Vaavu Atoll's most thrilling snorkel spots — a shallow lagoon where black tip reef sharks and eagle rays glide effortlessly through crystal-clear water. Our guides know exactly when and where to find them for an unforgettable encounter.
excursions.note: 🦈 These are reef sharks — completely safe and magnificent to observe. Our guides ensure a respectful, eco-friendly experience.

excursions.title: Turtle Point
excursions.shortDesc: Swim with resident sea turtles at their favourite feeding grounds in Fulidhoo's house reef.
excursions.fullDesc: Fulidhoo is home to a resident population of green and hawksbill sea turtles that frequent the reef daily. At Turtle Point you'll glide alongside these graceful creatures in their natural habitat — one of the most magical encounters the Maldives has to offer.
excursions.note: 🐢 Turtle sightings are almost guaranteed — our guides know their favourite resting and feeding spots on the reef.

excursions.title: Dolphin Cruise
excursions.shortDesc: Chase pods of wild spinner dolphins as they leap and dance in the warm waters of Vaavu Atoll.
excursions.fullDesc: Spinner dolphins are abundant in Vaavu Atoll and are famous for their acrobatic spins and playful behaviour around boats. Join us for a thrilling cruise as we seek out pods of these beautiful animals — often dozens at a time — in their natural ocean home.
excursions.note: 📸 Bring your camera — spinner dolphins are extremely active and almost always put on a show around the boat.

excursions.title: Coral Garden Snorkelling
excursions.shortDesc: Explore a breathtaking coral garden bursting with colourful reef fish, turtles, and marine life.
excursions.fullDesc: The Coral Garden is one of Fulidhoo's most beautiful snorkel spots — a vast, vibrant reef system teeming with hundreds of reef fish species, moray eels, octopus, and resident sea turtles. Perfect for all levels, this is the quintessential Maldivian snorkelling experience.
excursions.note: 🐠 No experience needed — our guides look after beginners and advanced snorkellers equally. The reef is incredibly accessible.

excursions.title: Leopard Shark
excursions.shortDesc: Spot the elusive and beautiful leopard shark resting on the sandy seafloor of Vaavu Atoll.
excursions.fullDesc: The leopard shark (also known as the zebra shark) is one of the Maldives' most beautiful reef creatures — docile, spotted, and stunning up close. Our guides know exactly where these incredible animals rest on the sandy bottom, making for an extraordinary snorkelling encounter.
excursions.note: 🌿 Leopard sharks are completely harmless and slow-moving — a truly rare and peaceful encounter with one of the ocean's most beautiful creatures.

excursions.title: Manta Ray
excursions.shortDesc: Glide with majestic manta rays at world-famous cleaning stations in the heart of Vaavu Atoll.
excursions.fullDesc: Vaavu Atoll is one of the world's premier manta ray destinations. Our guides take you to the famous cleaning stations where mantas gather daily to be cleaned by small fish — you'll be just metres away from these magnificent creatures as they effortlessly soar through the deep blue.
excursions.note: 🌿 Best from November to May. Manta encounters are almost guaranteed in season — this is a once-in-a-lifetime experience.

excursions.title: Whale Shark
excursions.shortDesc: Swim alongside the ocean's gentle giants — the whale shark — in one of the world's best spots.
excursions.fullDesc: Fulidhoo is one of the Maldives' most reliable locations to encounter whale sharks. These gentle giants — the largest fish in the ocean — are completely harmless and utterly breathtaking. Slip into the water beside them for an experience you will never forget.
excursions.note: 🌿 Best from October to April. We follow strict eco-guidelines — no touching, no flash photography, minimum 3m distance at all times.

excursions.title: Sandbank
excursions.shortDesc: Step onto a pristine white sandbank rising from the turquoise ocean — your own slice of paradise.
excursions.fullDesc: There are few things more magical than standing on a deserted sandbank surrounded by nothing but turquoise ocean and blue sky. We take you to a beautiful sandbar in Vaavu Atoll for swimming, snorkelling, and pure relaxation — the ultimate Maldivian escape.
excursions.note: 🏖️ Sandbars shift with the tides — we scout the perfect one each day to guarantee the best experience for our guests.

excursions.title: Picnic Island
excursions.shortDesc: Spend a magical day on a deserted Maldivian island — beach, snorkelling, picnic, and pure bliss.
excursions.fullDesc: Escape to a beautiful uninhabited island in Vaavu Atoll for a full picnic day out. Explore the island, snorkel the surrounding reef, swim in the crystal lagoon, and enjoy a fresh picnic spread under the shade of palm trees — an unforgettable full Maldivian experience.
excursions.note: 🌴 Our picnic islands are completely uninhabited — you'll feel like you have the entire island to yourself.
